evidence.craft: shot-08s: the palette matches the brief's rose-clay and oxblood and the edges are clean, but the defect letters swell into garbled overlapping blobs, and the 20s hairlines are thin enough to moire at thumbnail size.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: rose-clay ground with a centred oxblood snowflake, unlike the cream Penrose tiling of the last night; the six-arm star is still a familiar snowflake motif with no other visual idea.

pairwise_justification: The Penrose 2026-11-23 20s frame fills its triangle with dense ochre and rust kites on cream; tonight's 20s is thin hairlines on clay with blobby letters, so the Penrose night wins the vote on clarity and density.
